title: MSFS Marketplace Update: Heavy Iron Landing Challenges, Airline Schedules & Discovery Packs!
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest marketplace releases so you can skip the long store page menu guessing and know exactly what you are flying next.

The marketplace just dropped a massive wave of new content for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. If you're looking to bring maximum realism to your commercial airline operations, test your heavy jetliner handling, or explore bizarre landmarks across the globe, this week delivers an extensive lineup of curated bundles, airline schedules, and discovery packs. We divide the breakdown into four major categories:

✈️ Heavy Iron, Bundles & Commemorative Packs: A deep dive into high-inertia missions and classic liveries. We cover the Flyer Master Collection Vol. 6 (featuring classic A310 Pan Am, A310 American Airlines, and A320 Air Canada missions with authentic IFR charts), the America 250 United Airlines A320v2 commemorative pack with 12 real-world missions, and the Advanced Landings Heavies Master Collection by Perfect Flight—packing 72 landing challenges tailored for the TFDi MD-11, PMDG 777-300ER, and FlyByWire A380X.

📅 Global Airline Fleet Schedules (Summer Overhaul): A complete summary of real-world summer route schedules from VA Systems. We break down the route rotations and liveries for EVA Air, Spirit Airlines, Royal Air Maroc, SKY Airline, and Wizz Air, plus essential buyer reminders regarding base aircraft compatibility.

🌍 International Hub Traffic Overhauls: Real-world multi-airline timetable schedule injections across major global gateways. We highlight comprehensive schedule expansions for Addis Ababa (HAAB), Miami (KMIA), Barcelona (LEBL), Bogotá El Dorado (SKBO), and Chengdu Tianfu (ZUTF).

🗺️ Low-and-Slow Discovery Excursions: Throttle back with Koschi’s return in the Unique Places of the World series (Parts 11–16). From the aircraft graveyards of Roswell and European storage parks to natural wonders like the lips of Sudan and the Minnesota giant footprint, we check out these POI packs and share our top buyer recommendation on future bundle value.

Whether you want to tame the heavy inertia of widebody jets in the advanced landings bundle, populate major international gateways from Miami to Chengdu with authentic summer operations, or take a light aircraft out to spot bizarre landmarks, this marketplace drop offers massive replay value for your simulator.

Drop a comment below and let me know: Which of these items are you adding to your hangar, or are you holding out for an upcoming bundle? Make sure to smash the like button, subscribe to High in the Flightsim Sky for weekly flight simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
